title: Email Domain Warm-Up is now available to everyone in HighLevel Labs
text:
Warm up your dedicated sending domains right inside LC Email. You don't need a third-party warm-up tool, SMTP credentials or a separate subscription. Domain Warm-Up has moved out of beta and into HighLevel Labs, so any agency or sub-account can turn it on, with no request form or approval.
What's new
- Available to all users: Enable Domain Warm-Up yourself from Labs. The beta access form is no longer needed.
- Automated warm-up: We create warm-up mailboxes on your domain and gradually raise daily volume toward the goal you choose.
- Real engagement signals: Warm-up sends natural, threaded conversations with replies. Emails are marked as important and moved out of spam, which builds your reputation with Gmail, Outlook and Yahoo.
- Agency and sub-account domains: Both are supported.
- No impact on your contacts: The platform manages the warm-up mailboxes, so your contacts never receive warm-up emails.
What's changing: pricing
Domain Warm-Up will remain free through December 2, 2026.
Starting December 3, 2026, warm-up emails will cost $0.59 per 1,000 emails ($0.00059 per email).
The standard LC Email sending charge of $0.675 per 1,000 emails ($0.000675 per email) will apply in addition to the warm-up cost.
You only pay for warm-up emails that are actually sent. Your daily goal is a ceiling, and volume ramps up gradually, so early days cost less. You can pause or stop warm-up at any time to stop further charges.
How to get started
- Make sure your dedicated domain is verified and has an issued SSL certificate.
- Enable Email Domain Warm-Up in Settings → Labs.
- Go to Settings → Email Services → Dedicated Domain and IP and click Start warm-up.
- Choose a daily goal, for example 10K or 25K per day.
Domain health reporting
Each domain card shows a health score (0–100), deliverability, and emails sent today against your goal. Click View report to see SPF/DKIM/DMARC/MX status, an inbox vs. saved-from-spam chart, and details for each mailbox.
Good to know
- Results take a day or two to appear, so seeing 0% or 0 sent right after you start is expected.
- You can pause or stop warm-up anytime from the ⋯ menu on the domain card. Stopping early slows down reputation building.
- When warm-up is on, the old daily sending limit ramp is removed for that domain.
- If any DNS records show red in your report, fix those first. They lower your health score and deliverability.
- Domains already warming up during the beta keep running. Billing starts automatically on December 3, 2026, unless you pause or stop warm-up before then.
Coming soon

- Warm-up using your own email templates
- More warm-up mailbox settings
Learn more: Email Domain Warm-Up help article
